description: Relink or replace linked files (Links panel > Relink). Give target and filePath to point the targets at another file; with allInstances, every placement of the same file is relinked too. Give folder to replace missing links at once: each missing link is relinked to the file with the same name in that folder

allInstances.description: With filePath: also relink every other placement of the targets' current file. Default false

filePath.description: Absolute path of the new file

folder.description: Absolute folder to search for missing links by file name

target.description: Linked items to relink. With folder, optional: default every missing link

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: relink_images
title: Relink Images
